instruction: Open /home/user/Desktop/bracket_seed.step in BRL-CAD. Add a vertical plate of 10 x 40 x 60 mm at the left end of the base. Add a 60 x 20 x 10 mm cantilever extending rightward from the top of the vertical plate. Cut two 18 x 10 x 6 mm weight-reduction blind pockets in the cantilever, centered at X=30 mm and X=56 mm. Cut four through holes of diameter 5 mm in the base corners, with each hole center 10 mm from the nearest two base sides. Save the completed STL mesh as /home/user/Desktop/out.stl. [Software] Run `mged` from a terminal (use the full path if it is not on PATH).
